ValidationRule.description: Once an Opportunity moved to "Needs Analysis" stage, Regional Vice President is a required field for any Opportunity where the ATG Partner is Salesforce.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Once an Opportunity moved to "Needs Analysis" stage, Regional Vice President is a required field for any Opportunity where the ATG Partner is Salesforce and Monetization Ecosystem is CPQ, Billling, or CPQ & Billing.
